title: m3a review (m3a.review/1)
description: A review the owner made at the ground station (the gallery, a phone) or anywhere else, that `m3a review ingest <file>` applies (PLAN.md WP-8.2; packages/tools/src/intake/review.ts parseReview reads the same shape). Each decision carries the hash it was made on, whole or its first 12 or more hex digits: a submission's content hash, or a library clip's motion hash (spec/MOTION.md §7.6), as the queue's row gave it. A decision on what changed since is stale and not applied; the same decision again is no change. A note that opens with `threshold: ` or `task: ` is a proposal for the next WP.

by.description: Who reviewed, as a clip's review names them (the host's reviewer otherwise)

date.description: When it was made (the host's clock otherwise)

id.description: A submission id, or a library clip as SET/Clip

as.description: adopt, archive or reject a submission; approve or flag a library clip

theme.description: The feedback log's theme for the note (else a short `theme: ` the note opens with, else Review notes)
